To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the increasing digitization in the retail environment has a significant effect on consumer behavior at the physical store, (2) the presence of others moderates consumers' response to attribute based personalized advertising at the physical retail store, and (3) only free born providers of free e services possess customer orientation capabilities, which match the particularities in the free business model

(1) the social presence of other people in physical retail stores does not impact consumers' response per se, (2) it interacts with personalizability, (3) consumers' negative response in the social presence is mediated by embarrassment, and (4) moderated by consumers' perceived congruity between their self concept and personalized advertising.

1) The presence of others does neither influence consumer response to personalized ads nor does it moderate the effect of congruity, but rather it moderates the effect of embarrassment on consumer response to personalized ad.
